records.description: Screen Privacy Blur protects sensitive info during demos, calls, and recordings with a Chrome extension for web-page blur overlays and a macOS app for desktop-level manual blur. Hide tabs, chats, API keys, customer data, and notifications without changing your workflow.

records.name: Suppliers.Run
records.tagline: The AI that finds your suppliers in seconds
records.description: Finding the right supplier used to take weeks. Suppliers Run kills that. Tell it what you need. AI finds, verifies, and ranks suppliers globally — then hands you credibility scores, supplier contact info, and ready-to-send outreach templates. All in minutes. Supports finished goods, raw materials, OEM manufacturing, packaging, and more. Filter by country, volume, price target, and quality level. Built for importers, dropshippers, and anyone who sources products for their business.

records.name: Normal Anatomy
records.tagline: AI Aesthetic Alignment by a Nurse, Pilates & Fine Artist.
records.description: Anatomical variations are not deformities; they are your unique structural identity. Normal Anatomy is an ethical, data backed, holistic wellness app combining clinical skin analysis, postural alignment, nutrition guidance, and fine art colour theory. Built with a strict once-a-month scan limit to prevent toxic body checking. Your unique anatomical blueprint - movement, skin, nutrition and style guidance tailored to your body.

records.name: Infuro ERP Platform
records.tagline: Deploy AI Agents That Run Your Entire Business on Autopilot
records.description: Infuro is India's first Agentic ERP — AI agents autonomously manage sales, procurement, inventory, production, finance, and compliance. Unlike traditional ERPs that just store data, Infuro's agents act on it: auto-raise POs, sync multi-channel inventory, detect GST anomalies, forecast demand, and optimize logistics in real time. Built mobile-first with 50+ integrations (Amazon, Shopify, Flipkart, Tally) — the ERP that learns, decides, and executes for you.

records.name: 10LetterWords | Spelling Bee Solver
records.tagline: Ultimate solver for NYT Spelling Bee, Wordle & anagrams.
records.description: Free Spelling Bee helper, Wordle solver & 10-letter word finder. Instantly unscramble letters and find daily puzzle answers from a massive database of 370K+ words with a fast, responsive interface.

records.name: ASTIS Mail
records.tagline: Encrypt Gmail/M365 mail, calendar & attachments
records.description: ASTIS Mail adds client-side end-to-end encryption to Gmail and Microsoft 365 mail, calendars, and attachments—without migration. Business data is encrypted and decrypted on the user’s device; providers route and store ciphertext, while ASTIS servers never receive business data. Automatic key discovery, encrypted calendar invites, B2B organization controls, expiring key capsules, and HYOK make it practical for real teams.

records.name: SavedVids
records.tagline: Download web videos directly to your cloud storage
records.description: Download videos for free from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, Twitter, Threads, and 10,000 other video sites. Easily upload to the cloud for free.

records.name: Zolkit.com
records.tagline: Simple, fast, and secure mini-tools for everyday web work.
records.description: Zolkit is an all-in-one, privacy-first web toolkit built for developers, creators, and professionals. Run powerful tools like Markdown editors, regex testers, and video compressors directly in your browser. No uploads, no lag—just pure utility.

records.name: CRXPay
records.tagline: Monetization and analytics layer for browser extensions.
records.description: crxpay is the subscription platform for Chrome extension developers. Drop-in MV3 SDK, hosted paywalls, Bayesian A/B testing, Stripe Connect, live analytics without compromising users privacy.

records.name: Trading Tazos Game (TTG)
records.tagline: Collect, battle & trade digital tazos in 3D — real-time PvP
records.description: 🥏Trading Tazos Game (TTG) es un juego 3D open-source de batallas de tazos en navegador, sin cripto ni pay-to-win. Colecciona 351 tazos de Cybermon, Draco Bell y Minimon, combate en PvP en tiempo real o contra IA en 10 arenas. Incluye mercado, trades, torneos, 52 logros, 22 power-ups, 10 idiomas y PWA instalable. Hecho con Three.js, Next.js 16, Bun, Prisma, WebSocket, Tailwind y TypeScript.

records.name: PayFluence Nigeria
records.tagline: Nigeria's marketplace connecting brands with creators
records.description: Complete sponsored campaigns, perform micro-tasks, and earn rewards directly to your bank account with PayFluence.PayFluence helps businesses grow with real human engagement, while users earn by completing sponsored micro-tasks. From Google reviews, app testing, social media engagement, surveys, and product feedback, PayFluence connects brands with real users, not bots, and pays rewards directly to users.

records.name: Fathers Day Gift Ideas for Dads
records.tagline: fathers day gift ideas
records.description: Father's Day is a wonderful occasion to express gratitude and respect for your beloved father. Choosing practical, personalized, or heartwarming Father's Day gift ideas will help your dad fully feel your love. Learn more: https://familiro.com/blog/best-fathers-day-gifts-ideas

records.name: Fullpilot
records.tagline: Search 250M+ local business leads
records.description: Search 250M+ local business records, unlock available contact data, export accurate records, or turn on Fullpilot AI SDR to run outreach and handle replies.

records.name: Notuta
records.tagline: Property management that brings neighborhoods together
records.description: Notuta is the operating record for residential property managers across Europe: neighborhoods, units, incidents, meetings, and finances in one place.

records.name: GitArt
records.tagline: Turn your GitHub Contribution graph into pixel art
records.description: Turn your GitHub contribution graph into pixel art. Draw, pick a template, generate a commit script. Done.

records.name: 2Fronts
records.tagline: The App Store for AI Automations
records.description: 2Fronts is the AI automation marketplace built to help businesses adopt AI faster. Discover ready-to-use AI automations, purchase the solution you need, and start using it in under one minute. No complex setup, no long development cycles — just powerful AI workflows designed to save time and improve the way you work. From customer support to sales and daily operations, 2Fronts makes AI accessible for every business.

records.name: KARTA
records.tagline: Zwift routes in seconds: Strava loops, GPX ready
records.description: Find the right Zwift route for every workout and generate outdoor cycling, running, and walking loops in any city.

records.name: Passport Size Photo
records.tagline: Create compliant passport photos from home
records.description: Passport Size Photo helps you create compliant passport, visa, and ID photos online without visiting a studio. Upload a clear picture, choose the right country preset, check the crop and background, then download either a digital file for online forms or a 4x6 print sheet for home or pharmacy printing. Unlike generic photo editors, it is built around official document-photo constraints: exact dimensions, 300 DPI output, country-specific presets, and practical preview guidance before export.

records.name: Vibe Check
records.tagline: Paste the conversation. Find out what's really going on.
records.description: Vibe Check uses AI to decode any conversation — texts, DMs, emails — and tell you exactly what's going on beneath the surface. Paste a chat, get a tone analysis, red and green flags, a plain-English breakdown of what they actually mean, and three ready-to-send replies. No more staring at your phone wondering what they meant.

records.name: BigRoom
records.tagline: Market forecasts for stocks and crypto
records.description: BigRoom helps investors scan stocks and crypto with fast market reports, technical signals, forecasts and crypto liquidation heatmaps. It turns raw market data into readable context for faster research, not financial advice.

records.name: PopFast
records.tagline: Grow 1,000 X Followers in Weeks, Not Months
records.description: Learn to grow your X audience from 0-1000 followers in 30 days

records.name: Intelli
records.tagline: Convert leads into customers with AI conversations
records.description: Intelli is a WhatsApp Business API platform for SMBs in emerging markets. Automate customer engagement, run broadcast campaigns, collect payments, and manage support from one place across WhatsApp, web chat, Instagram, Messenger, and email. AI assistants are trained on your own data, with customer journey workflows and local payment rails.

records.name: Screwdom 3D 指南
records.tagline: 完整螺丝大师 3D 攻略：掌握所有 190 个关卡
records.description: 螺丝游戏终极指南，涵盖Screwdom 3D、螺丝分类和螺丝分类3d拼图。通过专家策略、技巧和逐步解决方案掌握所有关卡，适用于最受欢迎的螺丝分类游戏。Screwdom和螺丝拼图挑战的完整攻略。

records.name: talavo
records.tagline: ad-free, minimal, privacy focused browsing on iOS
records.description: A free browser for iPhone, iPad, and Mac that blocks YouTube ads, hides Shorts, and silences comments. Every feature is free, forever.

records.name: Tap2Order
records.tagline: Turn chats into orders instantly.
records.description: Turn your phone into a WhatsApp store in minutes. Sell products directly through WhatsApp with a beautiful mobile-friendly store.

records.name: Assignment Help Center Toolkit
records.tagline: 7 free AI-powered tools for perfect academic writing.⁠
records.description: A complete, 100% free academic toolkit designed to take the stress out of student assignments. Access seven powerful tools under one roof, including an accurate Citation Generator (supporting APA, MLA, Harvard), an AI Paraphrasing Tool, an essay rewriter, and plagiarism prevention utilities. Save time, format flawless reference lists, and elevate your research papers effortlessly. No hidden fees or account sign-ups required—just streamlined tools to help students succeed.

records.name: Hugogen
records.tagline: Modern task and issue tracking for product teams
records.description: HugoGen streamlines your product development, sprint planning, task management, and issue tracking for the AI era. Built from the ground up for cross-functional product teams.

records.name: Lume
records.tagline: Open Source chat bubble for your app
records.description: Embeddable AI assistant bubble for any React app. Self-hostable with Ollama. Fully customizable it reads the app context to understand and interact with your users the components, the data & the customization all yours.

records.name: Stop the World
records.tagline: A peaceful space to quieten the world's noise and find calm
records.description: An interactive digital sanctuary rooted in Ayurvedic principles. Stop the World combines an immersive 4-4-4-4 box breathing engine with an original, meditative sitar score. A minimalist space built to protect your focus and bring immediate stillness to a noisy day. Designed as a premium, standalone sanctuary, a doorway into our ecosystem of wellness and self transformation. Are you ready to stop the world? A Forge of the Soul apparatus.

records.name: CryptoPick.bet
records.tagline: Verified crypto casino reviews — KYC limits, withdrawal math
records.description: Most crypto casino review sites copy-paste bonus terms without reading the ToS. CryptoPick.bet does the opposite: every KYC threshold, withdrawal limit, and wagering requirement is verified directly from official Terms of Service before publishing. No fake 10/10 scores. No hidden affiliate bias. If a casino mandates KYC at $2,200 in cumulative deposits — we say so.
